hero.title: Speed reading, one word at a time
hero.description: RSVP shows text one word at a time at a fixed point, so your eyes never travel along a line. The red letter marks where to look.
hero.demoText: Speed reading means taking in text faster without losing the thread. On a normal page your eyes do not glide. They hop from point to point, pause, and sometimes hop back. RSVP, short for Rapid Serial Visual Presentation, takes the hopping away. Words arrive one at a time in a single fixed spot, so your gaze can rest. One letter in every word is marked in red. It sits at the optimal recognition point, the place where a word is recognised fastest. Paste your own text below and keep going.
